title: From Weather to Enhanced Weathering: Weather Foundation Models for Carbon Dioxide Removal at Operational Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.28973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) is a carbon removal solution with the potential to remove gigatons of CO$_2$ per year, but quantifying that removal today requires dense soil sampling and laboratory analysis. We evaluate five weather Foundation Models (FMs) as frozen encoders feeding lightweight decoders, under a leave-one-field-out protocol on 5,192 chronosequences from 264 fields across Brazil and the US. To our knowledge, this is the first holistic evaluation of weather FMs for ERW and the largest evaluation on operational ERW data. We find that across weather FMs, representations transfer to ERW: our best model, TerraNova-ERW, built on Aurora 1.5, positively orders measurements within fields it has never seen. translated_title: 从天气到强化风化：面向运营尺度二氧化碳去除的天气基础模型
translated_abstract: 增强岩石风化（ERW）是一种每年有潜力移除数十亿吨二氧化碳的碳去除解决方案，但目前量化其去除量需要密集的土壤采样和实验室分析。我们在来自巴西和美国的264个田块的5,192条年代序列上，采用留一田块协议，评估了五个天气基础模型（FM）作为冻结编码器并连接轻量级解码器的表现。据我们所知，这是首次针对ERW任务对天气基础模型进行的整体评估，也是在运营级ERW数据上最大规模的评估。我们发现，各类天气基础模型的表征可以迁移到ERW任务：我们基于Aurora 1.5构建的最佳模型TerraNova-ERW，能够在从未见过的田块内对测量值进行正向排序。然而，对新田块平均去除量的零样本预测尚不可行，我们将其归因于数据规模：同一架构在约10^5条自然风化序列上表现出色，这锚定了我们预期ERW数据必须达到的规模。
tldr: 该研究首次整体评估了天气基础模型在增强岩石风化碳去除量化任务上的迁移能力，其基于Aurora 1.5构建的TerraNova-ERW模型能够在未见过的田块内正确排序测量值，但指出实现零样本预测新田块去除量仍需更大规模的ERW运营数据。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first holistic evaluation of weather foundation models for Enhanced Rock Weathering carbon removal quantification, showing that the proposed TerraNova-ERW model built on Aurora 1.5 can positively order measurements in unseen fields, while attributing the current infeasibility of zero-shot field-level prediction to the need for larger-scale operational ERW data.
